```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          pwsh-version: latest

      - name: Install GitVersion
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet tool install --global GitVersion.Tool --version 5.*

      - name: Run GitVersion
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet-gitversion | ConvertFrom-Json

      - name: Resolve dependencies
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Resolving dependencies.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          .\build.ps1 -ResolveDependency -Tasks 'noop'

      - name: Build Module
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Module is being built.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          .\build.ps1 -Tasks 'build'

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Prepare the test pipeline.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          .\build.ps1 -Tasks 'noop'

          Write-Information -MessageData 'Load SMO stubs into session.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          Add-Type -Path './tests/Unit/Stubs/SMO.cs'

          Write-Information -MessageData 'Import module ConvertToSARIF into the session.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          Import-Module -Name 'ConvertToSARIF' -Force

          Write-Information -MessageData 'Import module PSScriptAnalyzer into the session.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          Import-Module -Name 'PSScriptAnalyzer' -Force

          $filesToScan = Get-ChildItem -Path './source/' -Recurse -Include @('*.psm1', '*.ps1') -File
          Write-Information -MessageData ("Will scan the files:`n`r`t{0}." -f ($filesToScan.FullName -join "`n`r`t")) -InformationAction 'Continue'

          Write-Information -MessageData 'Running PSScriptAnalyzer.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          $pssaError = $filesToScan |
              Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Settings './.vscode/analyzersettings.psd1'

          $parseErrorTypes = @(
              'TypeNotFound'
              'RequiresModuleInvalid'
          )
          Write-Information -MessageData ('Filter out reported parse errors that is unable to be resolved in source files: {0}' -f ($parseErrorTypes -join ', ')) -InformationAction 'Continue'
          $pssaError = $pssaError |
              Where-Object -FilterScript {
                  $_.RuleName -notin $parseErrorTypes
              }

          Write-Information -MessageData 'Converting PSScriptAnalyzer result to SARIF.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          $pssaError |
            ConvertTo-SARIF -FilePath 'results.sarif'

          Write-Information -MessageData 'Analyzing done.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Running unit tests.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          .\build.ps1 -Tasks 'test'

      - name: Validate Changelog
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $changelogContent = Get-Content -Path './CHANGELOG.md' -Raw
          if ($changelogContent -notmatch 'Get-SqlDscManagedComputerInstance|Get-SqlDscServerProtocol') {
            throw "Changelog does not contain entries for new commands"
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Changelog validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Verify File Endings
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $files = Get-ChildItem -Path './source/' -Recurse -Include @('*.psm1', '*.ps1') -File
          foreach ($file in $files) {
            $content = Get-Content -Path $file.FullName -Raw
            if ($content -match '\r\n\r\n\r\n') {
              throw "File $($file.FullName) has more than one blank line at the end"
            }
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'File ending validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Check Parameter Sets
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $getServerProtocol = Get-Content -Path './source/Public/Get-SqlDscServerProtocol.ps1' -Raw
          if ($getServerProtocol -notmatch 'ByServerName|ByManagedComputerObject|ByManagedComputerInstanceObject') {
            throw "Get-SqlDscServerProtocol does not contain expected parameter sets"
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Parameter set validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Check Error Handling
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $getServerProtocol = Get-Content -Path './source/Public/Get-SqlDscServerProtocol.ps1' -Raw
          if ($getServerProtocol -notmatch '\$PSCmdlet\.ThrowTerminatingError') {
            throw "Get-SqlDscServerProtocol does not use \$PSCmdlet.ThrowTerminatingError"
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Error handling validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Check Switch Statement
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $getServerProtocolName = Get-Content -Path './source/Public/Get-SqlDscServerProtocolName.ps1' -Raw
          if ($getServerProtocolName -notmatch 'break') {
            throw "Get-SqlDscServerProtocolName switch statement does not use break statements"
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Switch statement validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Check Unused Parameters
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $getServerProtocol = Get-Content -Path './source/Public/Get-SqlDscServerProtocol.ps1' -Raw
          if ($getServerProtocol -notmatch 'All parameter check outside switch') {
            Write-Information -MessageData 'Note: Parameter check outside switch may need manual verification' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Unused parameter validation completed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Validate New Command
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $managedComputerInstance = Get-Content -Path './source/Public/Get-SqlDscManagedComputerInstance.ps1' -Raw
          if ($managedComputerInstance -notmatch 'ByServerName|ByManagedComputerObject') {
            throw "Get-SqlDscManagedComputerInstance does not contain expected parameter sets"
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'New command validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Validate Help Documentation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $commands = @('Get-SqlDscManagedComputerInstance', 'Get-SqlDscServerProtocol')
          foreach ($cmd in $commands) {
            $help = Get-Help -Name $cmd -Full
            if (-not $help.Parameters) {
              throw "Command $cmd does not have proper help documentation"
            }
          }
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Help documentation validation passed.' -InformationAction 'Continue'

      - name: Final Validation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Information -MessageData 'All validations completed successfully.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
          Write-Information -MessageData 'Workflow execution finished.' -InformationAction 'Continue'
```
